disposition_reason: Table 2 gives range, median and quartiles of chromium, nickel, arsenic, cadmium, lead and mercury in 180 dried red jujube samples from three Shanxi regions.

study.design: Stratified random sampling of red jujube in three Shanxi production regions with health risk assessment
study.origin: Jiaocheng, Taigu and Xiangfen production regions, Shanxi Province, China
study.market: not market samples; sampled in production regions per GB/T 8855-2008
study.method: Microwave digestion (HNO3) and ICP-MS (iCAP RQ, He collision cell) per GB 5009.268-2016
study.qa: Jujube powder CRM GBW10204: recoveries 92-108% (Cr 0.228 vs 0.237, Ni 0.485 vs 0.502, As 0.089 vs 0.094, Cd 0.019 vs 0.020, Hg 0.0035 vs 0.0037, Pb 0.066 vs 0.07 reference mg/kg); blanks every 10 samples; RSD 2.9-4.5%

findings.notes: Pitted flesh dried at 80 then 60 C to constant weight and milled; dry basis. ICP-MS. Medians and quartiles printed as M (P25, P75); non-detects appear to be set to half the LOD in these statistics. Detection rate 100.0% (n=60).
